title: Irish Potato Casserole
description: A hearty Italian-inspired casserole featuring Irish potatoes and a creamy mushroom sauce.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and chopped onion to the skillet and cook for another 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked mushroom mixture, sliced Irish potatoes, and chopped parsley.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch casserole dish and top with grated Parmesan cheese.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for another 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
